title: SessionStorage Function-call via eval()
description: DOM-based XSS that reads a value from sessionStorage and passes it into eval() inside a function-invocation context.
objectives: Trace how the 'input' key flows from sessionStorage.getItem() into eval().
Break out of the surrounding processInput(...) call to execute arbitrary JavaScript.
Note that, unlike localStorage, this value only persists for the current tab's session.
hints: The value is inlined as eval('processInput(' + storedValue + ')') — close the paren, run your JS, and comment the trailing ')' out.
Reset the state with sessionStorage.removeItem('input') or sessionStorage.clear().
body:
SessionStorage -> eval() (function-call context)

Set sessionStorage.input to control the argument passed into processInput().
